Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer did not sufficiently verify or cite credible, authoritative sources to cross-check the address for The Queen Victoria pub from EastEnders. The agent predominantly relied on fan-created sources (such as Fandom and Wikipedia), which frequently mentioned 46 Albert Square without offering verification from official BBC materials or other trustworthy references. This reliance on community-driven sources without cross-referencing official media led to ambiguity in validating the canonical status of the address, especially given the fictional setting of Walford.
